purpose: threshold-agnostic DEER confidence frontier with direct submission of the parsed trial answer
reproduction_class: post-hoc frozen-trajectory DEER signal analysis; faithful DEER baseline remains unchanged
offline_decision: first non-empty parsed trial_answer with confidence strictly greater than threshold
fallback: frozen Full answer when no valid trial crosses threshold
threshold_selection: build on train/dev, freeze selected operating points before test reporting
accounting: main tokens through accepted Wait plus all trial output tokens through acceptance; prompt/prefill tokens reported separately
